cases.input: A strategy selects direct sales and rejects marketplace distribution.
cases.expect: Both choice and exclusion are explicit.

cases.input: The channel changes after an assumption is defeated.
A project list is labelled strategy without choices or horizon.
A scenario projection is relabelled as achieved outcome.
A StrategyRelease cites rationaleRef to WM-KNW-010, approvalActivityRef to WM-ACT-024 and issuedRecordRef to WM-REC-010 as three distinct referents and restates none of them.
cases.expect: The release is accepted and all three referents resolve independently.
cases.violates: none (exercises: Horizon and authority are explicit.)

cases.input: A StrategyRelease selects segment X through a direct channel and records marketplace distribution as an explicitly rejected alternative with its exclusion reason.
cases.expect: The release is accepted with non-empty excludedChoices.
cases.violates: none (exercises: Each release explicitly rejects an alternative.)

cases.input: An AlignmentAssertion links a WM-KNW-011 objective to a strategic theme with basisKind 'rationale' and a cited rationale reference.
cases.expect: The assertion is accepted and the basis is attributable.

cases.input: A strategic theme is moved from one strategy to another and is recorded as a new containment under the receiving strategy release.
cases.expect: The move is accepted as a new containment; the theme acquires no root identity and no independent lifecycle.

cases.input: A strategy reference entry names a referent identifier that is not in the admitted reuse set or the legacy-only set.
cases.expect: The entry is rejected and must be rewritten with target null and targetState declared-unallocated.
cases.violates: Blocked referents are never silently promoted.

cases.input: A StrategyRelease carries a single decisionRef intended to serve as rationale, approval occurrence and issued expression at once.
cases.expect: The release is rejected; three distinct referents to WM-KNW-010, WM-ACT-024 and WM-REC-010 are required.

cases.input: A strategic theme is submitted with its own identity, authority and lifecycle and no containing strategy.
cases.expect: The submission is rejected; a theme exists only within a Strategy release.

cases.input: A strategy release records a forecast figure and a realized benefit among its own attributes.
cases.expect: Both attributes are rejected; Strategy never records a forecast, an observed outcome or a realized benefit.
cases.violates: Strategy never records a forecast, an observed outcome or a realized benefit.

cases.input: A strategy release leaves excludedChoices empty and supplies a none-considered rationale in its place.
cases.expect: The release is rejected; a none-considered rationale does not satisfy the rejected-alternative invariant.
cases.violates: excludedChoices is non-empty; a none-considered rationale does not satisfy this invariant.

cases.input: An alignment assertion between an initiative and a strategic theme states its basis as a shared tag and a shared budget line.
cases.expect: The assertion is rejected; tag, budget line, portfolio membership and reporting line are forbidden bases.

cases.input: A WM-ACT-030 initiative record is registered as the strategy's choice set.
cases.expect: The registration is rejected; an initiative realizes a choice and is not the choice.
cases.violates: Initiatives and portfolios never substitute for strategy.
